tension: The challenge is not settling for inspiration by itself. It can feel rewarding to explore ideas together, imagine different futures, and get excited about what might be possible. But possibility only becomes meaningful when something is done with it. What makes this connection valuable is its ability to turn broad thinking into real direction, helping ideas move beyond discussion and into something tangible.
